SELECT guide.performance_viewing_guide_id, guide.performance_project_id, guide.entry_policy, guide.late_entry_policy, guide.recording_policy, guide.cancellation_policy, guide.accessibility_policy, guide.directions, guide.parking_information FROM performance_viewing_guide guide JOIN performance_public_page page ON page.performance_project_id = guide.performance_project_id JOIN performance_project project ON project.performance_project_id = page.performance_project_id WHERE guide.performance_project_id = #{performanceProjectId} AND project.deleted_dttm IS NULL AND

SELECT page.performance_public_page_id, page.performance_project_id, project.title AS project_title, project.production_start_date, project.production_end_date, project.place, page.slug, page.status_code, page.short_description, page.synopsis, page.director_note, page.genre, page.age_rating, page.runtime_minutes, page.intermission_minutes, page.admission_fee, page.hero_file_id, page.poster_file_id, page.accent_color, page.contact_name, page.contact_channel, page.organizer_name, page.og_title, page.og_description, page.og_image_file_id, page.publish_start_dttm, page.publish_end_dttm FROM performance_public_page page JOIN performance_project project ON project.performance_project_id = page.performance_project_id WHERE project.deleted_dttm IS NULL ORDER BY project.academic_year DESC, project.term_code DESC, page.performance_public_page_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO performance_public_page ( performance_project_id, slug, status_code, short_description, synopsis, director_note, genre, age_rating, runtime_minutes, intermission_minutes, admission_fee, hero_file_id, poster_file_id, accent_color, contact_name, contact_channel, organizer_name, og_title, og_description, og_image_file_id, publish_start_dttm, publish_end_dttm ) VALUES ( #{performanceProjectId}, #{slug}, #{status}, #{shortDescription}, #{synopsis}, #{directorNote}, #{genre}, #{ageRating}, #{runtimeMinutes}, #{intermissionMinutes}, #{admissionFee}, #{heroFileId}, #{posterFileId}, #{accentColor}, #{contactName}, #{contactChannel}, #{organizerName}, #{ogTitle}, #{ogDescription}, #{ogImageFileId}, #{publishStartDttm}, #{publishEndDttm} )
mapper.update: UPDATE performance_public_page SET slug = #{slug}, status_code = #{status}, short_description = #{shortDescription}, synopsis = #{synopsis}, director_note = #{directorNote}, genre = #{genre}, age_rating = #{ageRating}, runtime_minutes = #{runtimeMinutes}, intermission_minutes = #{intermissionMinutes}, admission_fee = #{admissionFee}, hero_file_id = #{heroFileId}, poster_file_id = #{posterFileId}, accent_color = #{accentColor}, contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_channel = #{contactChannel}, organizer_name = #{organizerName}, og_title = #{ogTitle}, og_description = #{ogDescription}, og_image_file_id = #{ogImageFileId}, publish_start_dttm = #{publishStartDttm}, publish_end_dttm = #{publishEndDttm} WHERE performance_public_page_id = #{performancePublicPageId}

UPDATE performance_viewing_guide SET entry_policy = #{entryPolicy}, late_entry_policy = #{lateEntryPolicy}, recording_policy = #{recordingPolicy}, cancellation_policy = #{cancellationPolicy}, accessibility_policy = #{accessibilityPolicy}, directions = #{directions}, parking_information = #{parkingInformation} WHERE performance_viewing_guide_id = #{performanceViewingGuideId}
